parts:

> Error in order(Year) : object 'Year' not found

Does ggvis not work with data.table objects, or am I doing something wrong?

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: data.table compatibility
parts:
Yes, it looks like ggvis doesn't work with data.table objects. But you just convert it to a normal data frame:

library(data.table)
library(ggvis)

df <- data.table(Year = as.integer(1:10), value = rnorm(1:10))

df %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  ggvis(~Year, ~value) %>%
  layer_lines()

-Winston
